page_title: POR 5-0 UZB | Portugal v Uzbekistan 23/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post.
90+3' Trincao (Portugal) is first to react to a loose pass inside the box, but slices his shot just wide of the right post.
90+2' That's the end of the game for Otabek Shukurov, who is replaced by Sherzod Esanov (Uzbekistan).
90+2' Fabio Cannavaro decides to make a substitution. Bekhruz Karimov will be replaced by Ruslanbek Jiyanov (Uzbekistan).
90+2' It is time for a substitution. Avazbek Ulmasaliev (Uzbekistan) is on for Bekhruz Karimov.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

87' 5 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Rafael Leao (Portugal) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a magnificent shot into the top left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Abduvakhid Nematov, so the score changes to 5:0.
87' Bekhruz Karimov (Uzbekistan) commits a foul and Jalal Jayed immediately signals a free kick.
85' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

84' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Abduvakhid Nematov, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
83' Portugal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Here comes a substitution. Rafael Leao (Portugal) is brought on as a substitute for Vitinha.

82' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Nuno Mendes (Portugal), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Portugal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
81' The Portugal players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
78' A wild pass somehow finds Eldor Shomurodov (Uzbekistan) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
76' Roberto Martinez has decided to substitute Joao Neves and he is replaced by Bernardo Silva (Portugal).

74' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Abduvakhid Nematov pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the left post.
73' Substitution. Abbosbek Fayzullaev walks off the pitch and Igor Sergeev (Uzbekistan) comes on as a substitute.
73' What a great touch by Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked.
73' Eldor Shomurodov (Uzbekistan) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
69' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
68' Today's referee Jalal Jayed rightly decides to book Renato Veiga (Portugal) for his harsh tackle.
67' Nuno Mendes (Portugal) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
65' The attendance for today's match is 68777.
63' Substitution. Joao Felix did his best and is replaced by Trincao (Portugal).
62' Azizjon Ganiev (Uzbekistan) tries his luck with a shot, but his effort goes wide of the target.
62' Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
60' 4 - 0 It's an own goal! Abduvakhid Nematov (Uzbekistan) puts the ball into his own net.
59' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

58' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the middle of the goal, but Abduvakhid Nematov makes a nice save.
57' Abdulla Abdullaev (Uzbekistan) commits a rough foul. Jalal Jayed stops the game and makes a call. Portugal earn a free kick.
56' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Azizjon Ganiev (Uzbekistan) takes it short.
55' Otabek Shukurov (Uzbekistan) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.

52' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Abbosbek Fayzullaev (Uzbekistan) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Diogo Costa easily catches the ball.
48' Joao Felix (Portugal) does well to evade a couple of challenges then let's fly from distance towards goal, but the effort flies just over the bar. That would have been a great goal!
46' Fabio Cannavaro has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Akmal Mozgovoy (Uzbekistan) comes on the pitch for Odildzhon Khamrobekov.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabio Cannavaro decided to make a change. Sherzod Nasrullaev (Uzbekistan) is replaced by Khozhiakbar Alizhonov.
46' The game is over for Pedro Neto (Portugal). Francisco Conceicao comes on for the second half.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Joao Cancelo (Portugal) is replaced by Nelson Semedo.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.

45+6' Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.

45+3' Odildzhon Khamrobekov (Uzbekistan) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
44' Otabek Shukurov (Uzbekistan) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
42' Joao Felix (Portugal) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
39' 3 - 0 It's 3:0! Bruno Fernandes feeds Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
34' Joao Felix (Portugal) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
31' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Uzbekistan due to a foul in the build-up play.
30' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Uzbekistan players aren’t happy.

29' Azizjon Ganiev (Uzbekistan) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the top left corner. He makes it 2:1 with this magnificent strike.
28' Sherzod Nasrullaev (Uzbekistan) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
23' A cooling break is underway.

23' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area. The opposition's defence outnumbers the attacking players inside the box and they manage to make a clearance.

21' Nuno Mendes (Portugal) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
20' Bekhruz Karimov (Uzbekistan) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jalal Jayed blows for a foul. Portugal are awarded the free kick.

19' Sherzod Nasrullaev (Uzbekistan) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Diogo Costa has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

17' 2 - 0 Nuno Mendes (Portugal) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.
14' Odildzhon Khamrobekov (Uzbekistan) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
14' Jalal Jayed blows his whistle. Odildzhon Khamrobekov (Uzbekistan) commits a foul after dangerous play. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Portugal.
11' Joao Cancelo (Portugal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
11' The resulting free kick from Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
10' Dangerous play by Bekhruz Karimov (Uzbekistan). Jalal Jayed blows his whistle for a foul. Portugal are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

6' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Joao Cancelo, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Cristiano Ronaldo (Portugal), who beats Abduvakhid Nematov with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
5' A pass by Nuno Mendes (Portugal) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Portugal take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
2' Bruno Fernandes (Portugal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

Uzbekistan will kick-off.
